notes.key_messages:
To maximise their chances of success on this paper, candidates should:
(cid:127) read all texts, rubrics and questions very carefully,
(cid:127) answer questions in French briefly and relevantly,
(cid:127) ensure that when they change an answer, it is clear what is their final answer,
(cid:127) check their work.
notes.general_comments:
Candidates dealt confidently with the variety of reading comprehension exercise types on this paper. All
candidates seemed to have ample time to complete the paper. The paper offered an appropriate challenge
and a gradient of difficulty. The standard of presentation and legibility was generally good but candidates
who change their mind about an answer must ensure that their final intention is clear.
